name: SULTANS OFSWNG
author: TC Helicon
shortDesc: Sultans of Swing — clean amp with lush modulation and harmony
desc: This is the SULTANS OF SWING preset from the Play Electric Factory Pack, shared here as a reference example. A clean amp tone with a slow, lush modulation effect that captures the warm, slightly wet character of the original recording. The harmony voice adds depth on the chorus sections. Works well on a single-coil guitar — a Stratocaster or Telecaster is ideal — with a light picking touch. Keep your input gain low to let the clean amp character come through.
